question: Which of the following countries did India defeat to clinch its maiden Women's Junior Hockey Asia Cup title?
solution:
The correct answer is **South Korea**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** defeated **South Korea** to clinch its maiden Women's Junior Hockey Asia Cup title.
 
• The match was a significant milestone in the history of **Indian women's hockey**.
 
• The victory showcased the rising talent and potential of **India's junior women hockey players**.
 
• This achievement has boosted the morale of the team and the entire **hockey community in India**.
 
• The tournament win is expected to inspire more young girls to take up **hockey** in India.
